unit: Paul English Applied Artificial Intelligence Institute (PEAAII)

labs.pi_title: Executive Director, PEAAII; Distinguished Professor of Computer Science
labs.research_summary: AI, data mining, machine learning and computational semantics applied in healthcare, environmental, astronomical and geological sciences.
labs.notes: Cross-disciplinary institute, not a PI-led lab in the usual sense; recorded as a single org-level entry under its Executive Director. Lead Planning Team and Curricular Working Group members hold their primary faculty appointments in other UMass Boston departments (English, Philosophy, Management Science, Computer Science) -- not duplicated as separate labs here.
